data.title: Summer Drought
data.description: The highest-numbered wheat field is parched (barren) for 1 round.

data.title: Bountiful Hills
data.description: The lowest-numbered brick hill becomes fertile (+1 yield) for 1 round.

data.title: Pirate raid
data.description: Pirates raid every coast. Each player with as many played knights as the pirates' strength (or more) takes loot; everyone else loses 2 random cards.

data.title: The tide rises
data.description: The sea rises to a height of 1 to 3 for 2 to 5 rounds: every coast tile, and every tile joined to it, no higher than that floods. A tide during a tide rises 1 higher.

data.title: Harvest Festival
data.description: Every player receives 1 resource of their smallest pile from the bank.
